subject: AP route decisioning & vendor onboarding checklist — Hearthwell next steps
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@hearthwell.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 19 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Quick recap + AP routing question (PO vs card)

Hi Alicia — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap from our side and a couple of ask items to help route this internally on both sides.

Call notes:
- Use case: batch inference for clinical alerts (low-latency, predictable throughput).
- Targeted rollout: pilot (3 endpoints) then expand to org-wide.
- Volume expectation: initial ~$18k/month token spend; expected to cross $75k/mo in Q4 if pilot succeeds.

Procurement & payment signals you shared:
- Procurement prefers paper PO for any committed spend > $10k/month.
- Card usage permitted for ad-hoc purchases under $5k; P-Card limits enforced by AP.
- Hearthwell is evaluating marketplace procurement (AWS Marketplace) but unknown timeline.

Ask / next steps:
1) Can you confirm the AP contact and the exact PO workflow (email to AP, portal, or Punchout)?
2) Please share any vendor onboarding form/AP checklist — I attached our standard net-terms draft and a one-page vendor requirements doc for your review.
3) If PO is the path, any preferred payment terms (Net30/45) and preferred billing contact?

Suggested mutual action plan (short):
- By 9/21: Hearthwell confirms AP routing (PO vs card vs marketplace) and sends vendor form.
- By 9/24: Redwood legal issues final net-terms; Redwood sets up trial invoice path if PO chosen.

CCing Lauren (CS lead) and Jordan (solutions) so we can scope the pilot limited to PO/card constraints. If PO is required for pilot commit, we’ll prepare a light-weight SOW to match your cadence.

Thanks —
Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: Hearthwell_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx (requested), Redwood_NetTerms_Draft.pdf (draft)
From: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@hearthwell.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marcus Li <marcus.li@hearthwell.ai>
Date: Mon, 21 Sep 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + AP routing question (PO vs card)

Rishi — thanks for the clear notes and the templates. Confirming a few items from our side:

1) AP routing:
- For pilot commitments that result in recurring spend above $10k/month our standard is to open a PO and issue to vendors.
- For one-off or proof-of-concept purchases below $5k we allow P-Card.
- We’re open to trying AWS Marketplace if Redwood gets listed for the model bundle, but that’s not in the pilot timeline (Q4 discussion).

2) Vendor onboarding form: attached the completed onboarding form (see Hearthwell_Vendor_Onboarding_Form.xlsx). AP requires two things to start PO: W-9 or foreign equivalent and an internal risk review signoff (procurement & security).

3) Terms: Procurement favors Net30 for pilot; we can discuss Net45 for committed annual contracts.

For the action plan — we’ll route the vendor form and W-9 to AP by EOD 9/21. I’ll copy the procurement intake ticket number once created.

Alicia
Alicia Turner
Head of Procurement | Hearthwell Analytics
alicia.turner@hearthwell.ai | +1 (212) 555-0199
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Turner <alicia.turner@hearthwell.ai>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 11:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Quick recap + AP routing question (PO vs card)

Perfect — thanks Alicia. Appreciate the quick turnaround on the onboarding form. A few execution notes from our side to keep the pilot moving smoothly:

- I’ll loop Legal to finalize Net30 in the draft terms you received; if AP needs vendor risk docs we’ll provide SOC 2 summary and data handling brief.
- Lauren will scope the pilot to honor P-Card limits if AP requests staged billing; Jordan will draft a lightweight SOW for a PO-friendly billing cadence.
- If you can share the AP ticket number and the expected PO creation ETA that helps our billing ops to reserve the vendor code.

Proposed dates:
- 9/21 EOD: Heathwell to open AP ticket (you mentioned) and share the ticket id.
- 9/24: Redwood sends final SOW + invoice template for PO.
- 9/28: Target PO issuance (if approved) so we can start pilot onboarding week of 9/29.

If marketplace becomes viable later, we can pivot billing and entitlement but this plan keeps the pilot on a predictable path.

Thanks —
Rishi

Alicia
